home.catalogSourceLocal: Built-in Seed Catalog (Sign in as Admin on Profile to seed Firestore)
home.transparencySubtitle: Dhruv Tales runs with zero AI APIs. Discovery uses plain database queries, and all audio/video playback resolves through an interchangeable MediaProvider adapter.

search.title: Discover Stories
search.subtitle: Filter by genre, language, creator, or search by title.
search.emptyBody: Try clearing one of your filters or searching with a different keyword.

story.premiumRequiredBody: Upgrade to Dhruv Tales Premium (Simulated) on your Profile page to unlock all premium episodes immediately.
story.dailyLimitReached: You have used today's free daily unlock allowance (2/day). Return tomorrow or upgrade to Premium.
story.signInToUnlock: Sign in to claim your daily free unlock and sync it to your Firebase account.
story.testLocalAudio: Test Local Audio or Video File (DemoMediaProvider)
story.localAudioHint: Verify the MediaProvider abstraction by loading any local MP3/WAV or MP4 file from your device for playback.
story.notFoundBody: The story you requested does not exist in the catalog.

player.demoAudioNotice: DemoMediaProvider: Procedural atmospheric audio bed (storage provider undecided).

video.shortcutsHint: Shortcuts: Space Play/Pause · ←/→ Skip 15s · F Fullscreen

interactive.noPressureNote: Playback paused — take your time. No countdown, no pressure.
interactive.constellationSubtitle: Every decision illuminates a new path across the constellation. Select any visited node to inspect your choice or replay from that crossroads.

library.title: Your Library
library.subtitle: Your listening history, saved stories, followed creators, and daily unlocks.
library.emptyHistory: You haven't listened to any episodes yet.
library.emptyBookmarks: No bookmarked stories yet. Save stories to listen later.
library.emptyFollowing: You aren't following any creators yet.
library.emptyUnlocks: No daily free episodes unlocked yet.
library.guestSyncBanner: Browsing as Guest — progress, choices, and bookmarks are saved locally on this device. Sign in to sync with Cloud Firestore.

profile.title: Account & Settings
profile.signInSub: Sync your listening progress, interactive choices, preferred media format, bookmarks, and daily unlocks across devices via Firebase.
profile.emailAuthConsoleNote: Note: Google Sign-In is pre-configured. Email/Password auth requires enabling the Email/Password provider in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.
profile.verifyEmailBanner: Please verify your email address to enable cloud sync with Firestore. Check your inbox for the verification link.
profile.subscriptionSimulatedNote: Simulated Checkout — No real payment gateway or charges. Writes a mock subscription record to Firestore so you can test Premium episode access.
profile.freePlanDesc: Access all Free episodes plus 2 Daily Free Unlocks every day.
profile.premiumPlanDesc: Instant access to every Premium & Daily Unlock episode across all series.
profile.seedSubtitle: Populate Cloud Firestore with 12 original stories (including 2 interactive branching series), 70 episodes, 8 genres, and 6 creators.
profile.seedAdminOnly: Sign in with an Admin account to seed Cloud Firestore directly.
profile.dangerDesc: Permanently remove your profile, listening history, interactive choices, bookmarks, daily unlocks, and Firebase Authentication account.
profile.confirmDeleteBody: This action cannot be undone. All your Firestore profile data, interactive story paths, bookmarks, and playback progress will be deleted.
